name: readmission_risk
title: Readmission risk
outcome: Unplanned hospital readmission within 30 days of discharge
label: 30-day readmission risk

metrics.platform_parity: the platform's inputs reproduce the author's own exactly: all 63 labelled admissions score identically at 24 hours
metrics.cv_note: The author's grouped cross-validation: AUROC averages 0.42, below chance; the single held-out 0.97 rests on 3 readmissions

trained_on: The 63 MIMIC-IV-demo admissions in the shared training data that carry a readmission label (47 for training)
limitations: Ten readmissions in all, three in the test set, and in the author's cross-validation the AUROC averaged 0.42 (range 0.12 to 0.75): it does not yet rank patients reliably, and the author's own notes call it a research prototype. For a patient without a hospital record (the synthetic patients), age and sex come from the registration and the record's history (prior admissions, length of stay, comorbidities, medicines) is set to the training medians: the result is marked as estimated. Steps, active minutes and the activity change are carried forward from the last recorded snapshot because the platform receives no activity data. The alert threshold is the author's exploratory threshold (0.329); below it the result is shown as low.
